readable_observations.readable_range: Lower-left source-switch heading, MD/MangaDex header and switch affordance, and both fine-note lines beneath them; right-middle source menu example.
readable_observations.observation: The source title acts as the source switch and replaces a full row of source blocks. The fine note says clicking the title opens a source list grouped into built-in and extension sections. It places add-source and source-list entries at the bottom of the list. The illustrated menu has a checked MangaDex row above a Komga row, separated by a thin rule.

readable_observations.readable_range: Upper-left primary/secondary/add button row and the lower-left source-switch fine note.
readable_observations.observation: The add example uses a white button with a dashed outline and a bold dark label. The source-switch note explicitly includes the add-source entry at the bottom of the list. These are reference affordances and placement notes.

readable_observations.readable_range: Lower-right toast heading, complete illustrated toast, and both fine-note lines.
readable_observations.observation: The heading specifies no occlusion and no dimming. The illustrated toast has a white body, black outline, black check mark and a shelf-added message. The fine note specifies disappearance after two seconds and refresh limited to the toast's rectangular area.

readable_observations.readable_range: Complete bottom pager heading, previous/center/next control row, and both fine-note lines.
readable_observations.observation: The example places previous and next controls at opposite sides with a central page fraction. The fine note places the pager immediately above bottom navigation without a separator, hides previous on the first page and next on the last page, expands all page numbers from the upper edge after tapping the center fraction, and allows horizontal swipes over the list to change pages. The displayed fractions are illustrative reference content.
